BOOTSTRAP.description: Khởi tạo, chưa có wave. Vào DISCOVERY (D0-D3) qua /discovery-start. Target reset sau /done-wave.

DISC_D0.description: D0 hypothesis-log. /discovery-start D0 spawn hypothesis agent (refine); /discovery-start D1 tiến wave (gate D0).

DISC_D1.description: D1 capability-map+persona-pool. /discovery-start D1 spawn capability-mapper (refine); /discovery-start D2 tiến wave (gate D1).

DISC_D2.description: D2 event-storming. /discovery-start D2 spawn event-stormer per domain (refine); /discovery-start D3 tiến wave (gate D2).

DISC_D3.description: D3 charter + PROJECT.md. /discovery-start D3 spawn charter-author (refine); /discovery-end (không arg) gate D3 → DOMAIN_AUTHORING.

DOMAIN_AUTHORING.description: DOMAIN authoring 2 lớp (continuous) — /domain-po (EPIC/FEATURE/JOURNEY) + /domain-ba (BR/PERSONA) author BUSINESS plain VN vào docs/domain/ → /domain-approve KÝ (status: APPROVED) → /domain-translate DỊCH sang eng docs/architecture/{epics,feat,journeys,business-rules,personas}/. /domain-end gate (domain_gate + planning_lint + translation_parity) → DESIGN.

DESIGN.description: Technical design — /design spawn solution-architect: ADR/HLD/API/data-model/UX/events/integrations. Gate → PLAN.

PLAN.description: Implementation plan — /plan spawn program-planner: WAVE-SEQUENCE + wave-{N} + MATRIX + KG skeleton. Gate → REVIEW.

REVIEW.description: Review + approve + launch wave (đổi tên từ INTAKE). /review-document loop, /approve-document set approved, /start-wave mở wave.

WAVE_OPEN.description: Wave đã materialize agents + KG + MATRIX. Chờ start dev.

DEV.description: Dev các boundary của wave (mỗi /start-dev 1 boundary, lặp được). Xong hết → /review-dev review cả wave.

REVIEW_DEV.description: Review agent ghi review-findings.md + trả open_findings (KHÔNG tự spawn). MAIN đọc → spawn fix Mode B → re-review tới open_findings==0. Gate no_open_findings chặn complete.

DEV_HANDOFF.description: Verify docker-compose + infra ready cho test agent chạy local.

TEST_EXECUTE.description: Build service local + run auto test, log bug (origin=auto) vào bugs.md. KHÔNG fix ở đây. Transition MANUAL_TEST sau khi chạy (pass HAY fail).

MANUAL_TEST.description: UAT manual + clear bug + RE-RUN test. Infra UP. /fix-bugs (Mode A) fix bug auto+manual (re-run TC verify, KHÔNG gọi review). /test-execute chạy LẠI full auto suite sau fix → bug mới/regression log lại → fix tiếp. Sạch (no_open_bugs) mới /end-wave.

DONE.description: Wave kết thúc, UAT signed. Chờ teardown hoặc CR amendment.

transitions.note: Revise loop. User cung cap feedback, agent revise doc. KHONG set approved.
User mark docs OK. Set approved=true in STATE. KHONG transition state. /start-wave gate check approved.
Dev thêm boundary khác trong cùng wave (multi-boundary). Xong hết mới /review-dev.
gate=all_boundaries_reviewed (wave-scoped, gates.py): mọi wave_boundary review_result=pass + coverage theo kind (BE80/BFF70/web60/mobile60) đọc từ STATE.review_results
gate=test-plan (gates.py): docker_compose_ok + connectivity_ok (infra status từ dev-handoff) + infra_proof (tracking/{wave}/docker-ps.json)
Auto-transition khi test-execute complete (có test_result, pass HAY fail). Bug auto fix qua /fix-bugs ở MANUAL_TEST.
Log 1 bug manual (UAT) qua log-bug-agent → append row bugs.md (origin=manual). Ở lại MANUAL_TEST.
In-state loop, agent chain fix + review
Re-run full auto suite từ MANUAL_TEST sau /fix-bugs. Chạy xong _auto về MANUAL_TEST; còn bug → fix tiếp; sạch → end-wave.
uat_signed + test_result=pass (lần test-execute cuối xanh, ép re-run sau fix) + no_open_bugs

CR amendment re-enter DOMAIN_AUTHORING: feature mới → /domain-po//domain-ba author business → /domain-approve → /domain-translate; CR chỉ kiến trúc → /domain-end qua thẳng → /design → /design-end → /plan → REVIEW → /start-wave.

self-loop: spawn ux-designer-agent (skill ux-design) — UX/UI cho FE boundary (ux-*.md + design-tokens.css). KHONG advance — dung /design-end.
gate design_gate (ADR>=3 + HLD + API + INTEG + per-boundary completeness). Advance DESIGN->PLAN.
